roles.title: Software Engineer
roles.description: Build data platforms, backend services and production AI workflows for insurance and clinical operations, from serverless ingestion to multi-agent RAG systems.
highlights: Built a serverless ingestion platform on AWS S3, Lambda, Kafka and Python that replaced fragmented vendor onboarding, cutting onboarding time by 80% while processing 20M+ insurance records per day.
Developed RefundGuard, a Python/FastAPI audit service that analyzed 500K+ insurance records to find overcharges, enabling $2M in customer refunds.

Built AskX, a multi-agent platform (FastAPI, RAG, SQL agents, classifier routing, fallback orchestrator) for clinical-trial queries: 200K queries per day and an estimated 73% lower resolution cost over 6 months.
Executed a zero-downtime migration of the configuration database from Aurora MySQL v2 to v3 using blue-green deployment, with cutover in under 10 seconds and zero data loss.
Developed agentic AI workflows with OpenAI APIs, LangGraph and FastAPI that route requests across retrieval and reasoning components, with fallback handling.

roles.title: Software Engineer
roles.description: Built cloud-native healthcare services and AI-assisted applications, with a focus on reliability, observability and secure service-to-service communication.
highlights: Architected scalable backend services in Java and Spring Boot for cloud-native healthcare workflows, improving modularity, reliability and maintainability.
Engineered LLM and RAG applications with Python, FastAPI, vector embeddings and semantic search, supporting 10+ enterprise knowledge workflows.
Built centralized logging and monitoring by integrating Splunk with custom Spring Boot actuators, decreasing mean time to resolution for production incidents by 25%.
Secured service-to-service communication across internal microservices with OAuth 2.0 and JWT authorization.
Implemented machine learning pipelines and MLOps workflows with PyTorch and TensorFlow, supporting 5+ model development and deployment workflows.

roles.title: Software Engineer
roles.description: Worked on backend services for a travel marketplace, keeping tour pricing and availability current across Australian destinations.
highlights: Developed Java and Spring Boot services to automate activity-data ingestion and synchronization, keeping tour pricing and availability current across Australian destinations.
Implemented Kafka-based event processing with Redis and MySQL to propagate inventory changes in near real time.
Integrated AWS services to retrieve, archive and monitor daily tour listings across key Australian cities.
Integrated Cloudinary as an image manipulation and CDN layer, reducing average page load times by 30%.

roles.title: Software Developer
roles.description: Developed backend payment-processing components and the APIs that connect them to customer-facing applications.
highlights: Developed backend payment-processing components in Java and Spring-based technologies for transaction and business workflows.
Engineered C++ components for performance-sensitive application processing in transaction-oriented workloads.
Built REST APIs and SQL-based data integrations that connect backend services to customer-facing applications.
Implemented unit and integration tests with JUnit to validate the service layer and reduce regression risk.
